title: Territory Sales Incharge-Calicut
description:
**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)**
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
KRA1 Accountability: Sales collection, C form collection & Ugai management \* Monitoring & reviewing company¿s & freight outstanding
  
  

* Reviewing the ageing of debtors on a daily basis
* Collections of cheques, DD from customers
* Coordination with service agent/C & F for ensuring collections in time
* Development & periodic review of critical ugai indicators
* Collection of all the C forms from the parties
* Ensure that the C forms are in proper format with all supportings and are dispatched to plant in time

KRA2 Achieving sales targets
  
  
Achieving sales targets of white cement & new products \* Ensure frontline implementation of zonal marketing plan
  
  

* Process & monitor daily sales figures & coordination with Logistics for supplying the material to the sales area
* Review the classification of stockists/retailers & direct users according to their lifting & other specified parameters
* Performing systematic market visit schedule activities
* Building rapport with all the customers
* Ensure collation of orders & feeding the same in e-commerce site on web
* Approval of credit note after checking all the details
* To fill in Daily Activity Report & call cycle enteries
* Attentively listen to customers problems/issues & apprise the same to area head/state head
* Attending to quality, pricing problems of the retailers/ stockists & direct customers
* Creating awareness of new products by converting features into benefits & spreading new products awareness through cluster meets & counter meets

KRA3 Gathering market feedback \* Provide the feedback & need for appointing new dealers/stockists in unrepresented areas or the areas which are not fully penetrated.
  
  

* Providing feedback on weak pockets of sales areas & the reasons thereof
* Closely interact with retailers/retailers staff/stockists to get the first hand market feedback & submitting the same to area head/state head
* Make available the information on competitors promotion activities to area head/state head
* Make available the information on competitors pricing activities to area head/state head & collection of bills as proof for the same

KRA4 Promoting products & applications \* To conduct retailers meet and coordinate with CASC personnel for imparting training to retailers on new products & technical aspects of products
  
  

* To collaborate with CASC personnel in conducting painters meet.
* To conduct & completely handle counter meets & spreading awareness of BW applications & products to painters of a specific counter
* To conduct trade exhibitions & ensuring the proper presentation at stall & attending to customers at the stall to spread awareness of the products & applications
* To conduct cluster campaigns after carefully selecting clusters of customers & making the end user aware of the new products & applications
* To coordinate & provide support to CASC personnel for sampling to be done at micro level.

KRA5
  
  

* Ensuring proper utilization of budget for promotional activities
* To ensure implementation of promotional schemes in retail channel & submit the first hand report of the schemes effectiveness
* Collection of tokens, issuals of credit notes for implementing the scheme
* Timely distribution of sales promotional material
* Ensuring that all advertisement material (POP material, posters, danglers) are properly displayed and that the visibility of the same is there
* To help direct parties, cement & paint manufacturers by assisting them & providing market trends & add value to their business
* Distribution of gifts & other promotional material to customers in time

KRA6 Initial complaint handling \* To attend to the complaints of customers with regard to minor & generic applications & products
  
  

* Visiting site to get the actual feel of complaint
* To take the initial account of the nature of complaint
* To attend to the complaints of retailers with regard to packing quality, product quality, weight complaints, damaged goods
* To handle the complaint as per standard checklist of complaint handling & liaise with insurance company for the damages settlement

title: Customer Relationship Manager Calicut
description:
* Principal Accountabilities

**Accountability**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Ensure effective execution of thebusiness strategy in the Region
  
  

* Devise and execute branch-level plans based on market analysis to ensure achievement of targets
* Ensure effective communication and awareness of targets by each team member
* Conduct periodic reviews and recommend corrective action where required
* Drive and motivate team members to achieve business targets
* Ensure branches allocated are manned adequately with quality manpower

Identify incremental business opportunities in the region through market intelligence & penetrate in underdeveloped market to enhance distribution reach
  
  

* Gain market intelligence in allocated geography
* Devise and execute in place strategies to tap potential market.
* Ensure recruitment of advisors in the areas having unexploited potential
* Enhance brand awareness in underdeveloped areas for future business

Ensure profitable and sustainable business by driving sourcing of high quality business sourced, market conduct in line with organizational and legal requirements as well as managing cost effectively
  
  

* Ensure that the business activities are carried out as per the compliance & regulatory guidelines laid by the company
* Put in place checks and balances to control the quality of business
* Take corrective actions as and when any malpractice or market misconduct is found
* Drive awareness and adherence to persistency targets
* Monitor each branch’s actual expenditure against budget
* Initiate measures to curb the less important expenses & drive profitability at the branches
* Drive branch profitability by taking new cost optimization initiatives

Ensure high levels of motivation and productivity in the team by effective implementation of sales promotion & R & R programs and implementation of sales tools and processes
  
  

* Implementing Sales progression across the levels wherein people are more assured of career enhancement on delivery of the expectations
* Drive periodic zonal and organizational R&R initiatives and motivate team towards peak achievements
* Effectively communicate the promotional program to the entire sales team.
* Ensure branches plan the incremental revenues through these programs.
* Ensure the delivery of results during the program period
* Give feedback on the results of the promotional program.
* Identify opportunities, drive and monitor productivity enhancement initiatives
* Communicate the effective use of sales process to the entire sales team
* Plan and review the process at the BM/BH/ReM. FLS and the Advisor level and obtain the feedback for further enhancement.
* Facilitate the maintenance of proper database on day to day activities to monitor performance

Ensure streamlined teamwork with support functions such as Operations, Sales Training, Marketing, Compliance and HR to ensure achievement of regional business goals
  
  

* Giving proper support to the Operations team to improve the login to completion ratios for new business sourced as well as servicing to existing clients.
* Ensure team members are a part of planned Training initiatives so as to ensure they are adequately equipped in terms of knowledge and skill.
* Work with the HR team for manpower hiring, engagement and retention across region
* Work with the Zonal Compliance team to ensure awareness of prevailing guidelines, and taking proactive and corrective measures to ensure proper market conduct as stipulated
* Provide inputs for improvement of processes across all support functions

Team Development
  
  

* Ensure through continuous on the job training, skill enhancement of team members

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Title: Business Development Executive

Location: Malappuram, Kerala

Experience: Min. 2 Years in Sales/BD (MEP/Construction preferred)

Salary: Competitive + Incentives

Are you a sales professional with a passion for the construction and MEP industry? Do you have a knack for building relationships in Kozhikode?

EENOKI INFRA CONSULTANCY is looking for a dynamic Business Development Executive to join our growing team. If you are results-driven and ready to take ownership of our client expansion, we want to hear from you.

📋 Key Responsibilities:

* Lead Generation: Identify new opportunities through market research and networking.
* Relationship Building: Connect with architects, builders, and facility managers to promote our MEP services.
* Sales Cycle Management: From scheduling meetings to negotiating contracts and closing deals.
* Strategy: Track market trends and competitor activities to keep us ahead.

**✅ Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or Engineering.
* Strong track record in B2B sales or client acquisition.
* Fluency in both Malayalam and English is required.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

**🚀 Why Join Us? At EENOKI, we value strategic thinking and problem-solving. We offer a competitive package and a supportive environment for you to grow your career in the infrastructure sector.**

**📩 How to Apply: Send your resume to hr@eenoki.com with the subject "Application for Business Development Executive."**
